methodology.contexts: Fresh storage/cookies per sample; warm browser process, HTTP cache disabled, service workers blocked.
methodology.network: CDP profile on static assets; intercepted APIs have an explicit 150ms delay. API payload bandwidth and production server/DB time are not modeled.
methodology.interaction: Wall-clock automation actions to asserted content plus two animation frames; includes Playwright overhead. Mobile search uses inherited Ctrl+K workaround.
methodology.scrolling: 60 scripted requestAnimationFrame scroll intervals, not a touch-gesture latency metric.
methodology.observers: Raw longtask and layout-shift entries when supported. Layout-shift values are not a computed CLS score.
methodology.statistics: p75 nearest rank (ceil(n*0.75)); five samples establish a local baseline, not field p75.
